chunks: As commands from Us. It is indeed We who send (messengers),
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'commands from Us' signify in Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Dukhan, this verse underscores the directness of divine decree, affirming that the punishment and the dispatch of the messenger were preordained by God's will rather than contingent events. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a demonstration of God's absolute sovereignty (Mulk) and the inevitability of His judgment, reinforcing the theological concept that all affairs originate from His command.
